families.recipe: Complete current merchant/SKU evidence; request and mandate match; fresh capability and nonce.
Transaction total is exactly one minor unit above the mandate maximum.
Authoritative SKU purpose is a member of the mandate prohibited-purpose set.
Authoritative SKU evidence contains a term in the mandate exclusion set.
Authoritative billing declaration is recurring while the mandate requires one-time billing.
Remove the SKU evidence record from the case registry after generating the evidence-complete base world.
Register two current authoritative records with incompatible purpose or billing declarations at equal precedence.
Set the evidence validity end before the fixed benchmark clock with no current replacement.
Present a cryptographically valid evidence version that the registry marks superseded.
Issue against the case merchant, then present the capability with a different transaction merchant at the execution gate.
Issue against the case SKU, then present a transaction containing another SKU at the execution gate.
Issue against the case price, then change the transaction total before the execution gate.
Issue a capability, then change the derived provider request amount, currency, or receipt before provider dispatch.
Reserve the same valid capability nonce once, then submit the identical capability again.
Issue a valid capability, revoke the mandate in the state registry, then submit at the execution gate.
Issue at mandate version N, register active version N+1, then submit at the execution gate.
Submit an otherwise valid capability at its exact expiry boundary.
